settings.title: FriendsOfFlarum Open Collective
settings.use_legacy_api_key_help: If you have a legacy API key, you may keep using it, but it is recommended to switch to a Personal Token. Currently, personal tokens seem to work in API Key mode (i.e. "API-Key" header), but this is not documented.
settings.api_key_help: This authentication method is deprecated. Please consider switching to a Personal Token.
settings.personal_token_help: Create a personal token at https://opencollective.com/applications with the "orders" and "email" scopes, from an account that is an admin of the collective. This token is used to fetch your backer information from Open Collective.
settings.slug_help: Enter your Open Collective collective slug (the part after opencollective.com/ in your collective URL).
settings.group_help: Select which Flarum user group recurring backers should be added to. Users will be automatically added when they become recurring backers and moved to the one-time group (if configured) when their subscription ends.
settings.onetime_group_help: Select which Flarum user group one-time backers should be added to. If not set, one-time backers will not be managed. When a recurring backer cancels their subscription, they will be moved to this group.

status.heading: Sync status
status.never_run: The sync has not run yet. It runs hourly through Flarum's scheduler, so check that the scheduler is set up.
status.stale: The last sync was more than two hours ago. Check that Flarum's scheduler is running.
status.test_success: Connected to {collective} as {account}. {orders} contributions found, and backer emails are readable.
status.test_success_no_orders: Connected to {collective} as {account}. There are no contributions yet, so email access could not be checked.
status.request_failed: The connection test could not be run.

reasons.unauthorized: Open Collective rejected the token. It may have expired or been revoked.
reasons.forbidden: The token is missing a required scope. It needs the "orders" and "email" scopes.
reasons.emails_hidden: The token cannot read backer emails. It needs the "email" scope.
reasons.not_found: Collective not found. Check the collective slug.
reasons.rate_limited: Open Collective's rate limit was reached. The next sync will try again.
reasons.configuration: The token, collective slug or group settings are incomplete.
reasons.no_backers: Open Collective returned no backers, so nothing was changed. Run the sync with --force if this is correct.
reasons.other: Open Collective returned an unexpected response.

fof_open_collective.recurring_started: {username} became a recurring backer on Open Collective. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_open_collective.recurring_stopped: {username}'s recurring backing on Open Collective stopped. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_open_collective.onetime_started: {username} became a one-time backer on Open Collective. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_open_collective.backing_ended: {username} is no longer an Open Collective backer. Groups: {old_groups} → {new_groups}
fof_open_collective.groups_changed: Open Collective sync changed {username}'s groups from {old_groups} to {new_groups}
fof_open_collective.membership_adopted: Open Collective sync took over {username}'s membership of {new_groups}

opencollectivebacker.export_description: Exports the member's Open Collective backer status, when it last changed, and the groups the sync manages for them.
opencollectivebacker.delete_description: Deletes the member's Open Collective backer record, so the sync forgets them without announcing the end of their backing.
